en.title: Mystery Algorithm — Generalized Euclidean Subtraction
en.description:
The original problem gives pseudocode for repeated subtraction and asks for the result when a=2437, b=875. This site generalizes the same algorithm to read any two positive integers and output x=y at the point where the algorithm terminates.

The input protocol and the generalized ranges are additions by this site; they do not mean the original problem used stdin/stdout.
en.input: One line with two positive integers a, b. Ranges added by this site: 1≤a,b≤10^9.
en.output: Output the equal value that this repeated-subtraction algorithm ends with.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, correctness, and complexity.
hints: Trace the state changes step by step; pay special attention to when the increment in the loop condition happens and to the execution order of finally.
